claim: honours a customer who drank the house's wine devotedly from 1944 until his death
because: The fact is in the stem, not an option. Churchill drank Pol Roger from 1908. His wine merchant's invoices that year record the 1895 vintage in bottles and half bottles. 1944 is when he met Odette Pol-Roger at the British Embassy party in Paris, which began the close friendship with the family, not when he began drinking the wine.
fix: Cuvee Sir Winston Churchill honours a customer who drank the house's wine from 1908 until his death and became a friend of the family after 1944. Which house bottles it?
